Yamask

Ghost

Unova · Generation 5

Yamask is a Ghost-type Spirit Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 1.5 kg. It evolves into Cofagrigus and Runerigus. Its highest base stat is Defense (85), with a base stat total of 303.
